Rather, it is necessary to fast from evening to evening, and not as dictated in the Korah, and since the beginning of Lent will be from the ninth day, and on the tenth day, it is necessary to fast as dictated, but on the tenth day of the new month, the fast will be more from west to evening, and the reading will not be dictated, but from evening to evening. And in this, Shafir of the tongue sits down, and that the Gemara is interested, that is, how is it possible to fast on the ninth day and begin to fast from the beginning on the ninth day, and not on the tenth, one is interested because of the verse, and so you are tortured more from west to evening and read not the spelling of the most and the second day of the day, Nami dish fasting on the ninth day, but if the Omnipresent does not fast, it is like the rest Fasting This religious fasting is by what I eat and drink and consider as fasting. Rather Daksha why didn't he say in Hadiya and you ate on the ninth day. And at that time the reward for the mitzvah was eating, and it is not as much as the reward for fasting. And according to this, it is difficult for him not to do a mitzvah, and he does not have a reward for a mitzvah and he does it, and so it is tafi, the reward for eating a mitzvah that was commanded, than to take a reward for the fasting that was not commanded. For this he gave an excuse like the ninth and tenth tortures, and the tenth prayer he was commanded. And the eating of the ninth is important and a parasite' to the fasting commandments of the tenth. It is found that the commandment of the tenth fast on both of them as above is very true. In the act of Dahait brought by the column and the deceased said to him and why did you buy a gold fish for five gold coins and no more than that you took from the hand of my servant whom I sent to buy for me he replied and that we did not buy him ten gold coins to eat on this day that the Holy One commanded Blessed is he to eat and drink, and we are sure that the Omnipresent will atone for our seasons. the Omnipresent is so beautiful. You did such a hard thing. What was the answer for taking from the hand of his servant. And Rashel Tirtz said that the act was that the seller demanded for him, the Omnipresent, this much or more, and it was not worth the blood that he demanded, and he replied that your servant did not buy it at such a high price when the seller demanded it, and I did not buy it from the hand of your servant, because even if there was no buyer there 21 I am alone and there was also a claim.
